card.name: Web pages and links, before URLs
card.fires_on: Web-related nouns such as pages, sites, links or web, and URL pieces like :// after http, mostly in text about search engines and crawling. These are places where a web address could come next.

modes.label: Web page nouns
modes.description: The words pages, sites, links or web in text about search engines, crawlers and indexing.
modes.example: use crawlers to find<< pages>> for their algorithmic search results.

modes.label: Inside web addresses
modes.description: Punctuation within a URL right after http or www.

modes.label: Sharing or reporting on sites
modes.description: Words like on or links in calls to review or report on websites.
modes.example: please give it a quick review<< on>> ycombinator or StumbleUpon

card.writes: It lowers the odds of http, https and www coming next, so it holds back a web address.
card.plain: It fires on words about websites and links, and it keeps the model from writing a web address next.
